responsibility: Builds the local crate’s HIR owner map by walking the HIR tree and recording each node with its parent, owner-local storage, and stable hash information. This file owns the `NodeCollector` traversal that populates `HirOwnerData`, inserts bodies into their owners, handles special parentage cases such as exported macros and variant constructors, and computes the crate hash inputs from hashed HIR bodies and source/upstream crate metadata.
